name: Push-up
instructions: Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels; lower with control.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Place hands on a stable raised surface and lower your chest toward it.

name: Decline push-up
instructions: Elevate feet on a stable surface; keep ribs and hips aligned.

name: Knee push-up
instructions: Keep a straight line from knees through shoulders while pressing.

name: Wide-grip push-up
instructions: Set hands wider than shoulders and keep elbows comfortably bent.

name: Close-grip push-up
instructions: Place hands beneath shoulders and lower without flaring elbows.

name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Bring hands close beneath the chest and keep the movement controlled.

name: Archer push-up
instructions: Shift toward one bent arm while the opposite arm stays extended.

name: Forward-lean dip
instructions: Lean slightly forward and lower only through a comfortable range.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor and press dumbbells up without bouncing elbows.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lower dumbbells beside the chest, then press while keeping wrists stacked.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Keep feet planted and lower the bar under control to the mid-chest.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set the bench to a modest incline and press without arching excessively.

name: Incline barbell press
instructions: Lower the bar toward the upper chest with a steady, even path.

name: Dumbbell chest fly
instructions: Use a light load and a soft elbow bend; stop before shoulders strain.

name: Cable chest fly
instructions: Bring handles together in a smooth arc without shrugging.

name: Machine chest press
instructions: Adjust handles near chest height and press without locking elbows.

name: Standing band chest press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and press forward with a stable stance.

name: Bent-over barbell row
instructions: Hinge at the hips and row toward the lower ribs with a neutral spine.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench and pull the dumbbell toward your hip.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and row without lifting the torso.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall and draw the handle toward your waist without rocking.

name: Close-grip cable row
instructions: Use a neutral grip and keep shoulders down as you pull.

name: Wide-grip lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar toward the upper chest; avoid pulling behind the neck.

name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
instructions: Keep torso steady and pull elbows down toward your sides.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Start from a controlled hang and pull without swinging.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Use an underhand grip and lower slowly to a comfortable hang.

name: Assisted pull-up
instructions: Set assistance so each repetition stays smooth and controlled.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Keep the body straight and pull the chest toward a secure bar.

name: Single-arm cable row
instructions: Brace your trunk and row one handle toward your waist.

name: Straight-arm pulldown
instructions: Keep elbows softly bent and pull the bar toward your thighs.

name: Conventional deadlift
instructions: Brace, keep the bar close, and stand by driving through the floor.

name: Rack pull
instructions: Set the bar above the floor and hinge with a braced, neutral back.

name: Back extension
instructions: Hinge at the hips and stop when your body forms a straight line.

name: Prone back extension
instructions: Lift arms and legs slightly while keeping the neck relaxed.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Pull the band apart at chest height while keeping shoulders relaxed.

name: Cable face pull
instructions: Pull the rope toward eye level and finish with elbows out.

name: Standing barbell overhead press
instructions: Brace your midsection and press the bar overhead in a straight path.

name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Press dumbbells overhead without shrugging or arching your back.

name: Arnold press
instructions: Rotate palms forward as you press, using a comfortable range.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Raise light dumbbells to the sides with a soft elbow bend.

name: Cable lateral raise
instructions: Raise the handle out to the side without leaning away.

name: Dumbbell front raise
instructions: Raise one or two light dumbbells to shoulder height with control.

name: Plate front raise
instructions: Hold a light plate and raise it to shoulder height without swinging.

name: Bent-over rear-delt fly
instructions: Hinge forward and open the arms while keeping the neck neutral.

name: Reverse pec deck
instructions: Set handles at shoulder level and move arms apart smoothly.

name: Cable upright row
instructions: Use a comfortable grip and stop at a pain-free height.

name: Half-kneeling landmine press
instructions: Kneel tall and press the bar forward and upward with control.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Raise hips and lower the head between hands within a comfortable range.

name: Wall handstand hold
instructions: Use a clear wall space and hold only if you can enter and exit safely.

name: Resistance-band overhead press
instructions: Stand on the band and press handles overhead with a steady torso.

name: Dumbbell shrug
instructions: Lift shoulders toward ears, pause, then lower without rolling them.

name: Barbell shrug
instructions: Hold the bar at your thighs and elevate shoulders straight upward.

name: Band external rotation
instructions: Keep elbow near your side and rotate the forearm outward gently.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Keep elbows by your sides and curl without swinging.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Keep palms facing inward and lower each dumbbell slowly.

name: Barbell curl
instructions: Stand tall and curl the bar while keeping elbows near your sides.

name: EZ-bar curl
instructions: Use a comfortable angled grip and avoid leaning back.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench and curl without moving upper arms.

name: Concentration curl
instructions: Brace your elbow against your inner thigh and curl steadily.

name: Preacher curl
instructions: Keep upper arms supported and avoid fully locking the elbows.

name: Cable biceps curl
instructions: Keep wrists neutral and maintain tension through the lowering phase.

name: Reverse curl
instructions: Use an overhand grip and curl with a lighter, controlled load.

name: Zottman curl
instructions: Curl palms-up, rotate at the top, then lower palms-down slowly.

name: Cross-body hammer curl
instructions: Curl each dumbbell toward the opposite side of your chest.

name: Resistance-band curl
instructions: Stand on the band and curl while keeping elbows close.

name: Cable behind-body curl
instructions: Stand slightly forward of the cable and curl without rotating the torso.

name: Spider curl
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and curl without swinging.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows tucked and press the handle down smoothly.

name: Rope triceps pushdown
instructions: Separate the rope ends at the bottom without moving your shoulders.

name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
instructions: Keep upper arms steady and lower the dumbbell behind your head comfortably.

name: Lying triceps extension
instructions: Lower the bar toward the forehead with elbows angled slightly back.

name: Close-grip bench press
instructions: Use a moderate grip and keep wrists stacked over elbows.

name: Bench dip
instructions: Keep shoulders comfortable and bend elbows only through a safe range.

name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Keep hands close and lower under control; use an incline to scale.

name: Single-arm cable pushdown
instructions: Keep elbow close and extend one arm without twisting.

name: Band triceps pressdown
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and extend elbows with a steady torso.

name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
instructions: Hinge forward, hold upper arm still, and extend the forearm.

name: Cross-body cable extension
instructions: Extend the handle across your body while keeping the upper arm stable.

name: Tate press
instructions: Lie on a bench and lower dumbbells toward the chest with elbows bent.

name: Dumbbell triceps pullover
instructions: Lower a light dumbbell behind the head, then extend elbows upward.

name: Single-arm overhead cable extension
instructions: Face away from the cable and extend one arm overhead smoothly.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Sit hips back and keep knees tracking in line with toes.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold weight at the chest and squat to a comfortable depth.

name: Barbell front squat
instructions: Keep elbows high and brace before each controlled repetition.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Brace, sit between hips, and keep the bar balanced over mid-foot.

name: Split squat
instructions: Use a staggered stance and lower straight down with balance.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Rest rear foot on a stable support and lower under control.

name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Step back, lower gently, and push through the front foot to return.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Take controlled alternating steps and keep the front knee stable.

name: Dumbbell step-up
instructions: Use a stable step and drive through the elevated foot without bouncing.

name: Leg press
instructions: Lower the sled only as far as hips stay supported and comfortable.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Align the machine pivot with your knee and extend smoothly.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Slide down a wall to a comfortable hold and keep breathing.

name: Box squat
instructions: Touch a stable box lightly, then stand without rocking backward.

name: Sumo squat
instructions: Set a wide stance, turn toes out slightly, and squat with control.

name: Hack squat
instructions: Keep your back supported and use a comfortable depth.

name: Heel-elevated squat
instructions: Elevate heels slightly and keep the torso tall as you squat.

name: Lateral step-up
instructions: Stand beside a low stable step and control the sideways step-up.

name: Sled push
instructions: Brace and push a manageable load with short, steady steps.

name: Assisted sissy squat
instructions: Hold a stable support and use a short, pain-free range.

name: Single-leg press
instructions: Use one leg at a time and keep hips level on the pad.

name: Lying hamstring curl
instructions: Curl heels toward hips while keeping pelvis against the pad.

name: Seated hamstring curl
instructions: Set the pad above the ankles and curl smoothly through range.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Push hips back with soft knees and keep weights close to legs.

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips, keep the bar close, and stop before the back rounds.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge on one leg with hips square; use support for balance if needed.

name: Barbell good morning
instructions: Use a light load, brace firmly, and hinge without rounding the back.

name: Assisted Nordic curl
instructions: Anchor ankles securely and use hands to assist the controlled lowering.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Press through feet and lift hips without arching the lower back.

name: Barbell hip thrust
instructions: Rest upper back on a stable bench and finish with ribs down.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
instructions: Secure a dumbbell across hips and extend hips smoothly.

name: Frog pump
instructions: Bring soles together and lift hips with a short controlled range.

name: Lateral band walk
instructions: Keep knees softly bent and take small, controlled side steps.

name: Side-lying clamshell
instructions: Keep feet together and open the top knee without rolling hips back.

name: Cable glute kickback
instructions: Brace and extend one leg behind without arching the lower back.

name: Quadruped glute kickback
instructions: On hands and knees, press one heel back while keeping hips level.

name: High step-up
instructions: Choose a stable step and drive through the whole working foot.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
instructions: Keep hips level as you bridge with one foot planted.

name: Cable pull-through
instructions: Hinge back with the rope between legs, then stand by extending hips.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hinge sharply and let hips drive the bell; keep arms relaxed.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lower opposite arm and leg while keeping the low back gently grounded.

name: Forearm plank
instructions: Keep shoulders, hips, and heels aligned while breathing steadily.

name: Side plank
instructions: Stack shoulders and hips; bend knees to scale the hold.

name: Bird dog
instructions: Reach opposite arm and leg while keeping the trunk still.

name: Hollow body hold
instructions: Keep the low back grounded and bend knees to make the hold easier.

name: Abdominal crunch
instructions: Curl shoulders gently from the floor without pulling on the neck.

name: Reverse crunch
instructions: Bring knees toward chest by curling the pelvis, not swinging legs.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Rotate ribs toward the opposite knee with a slow controlled tempo.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: Hold a strong plank and alternate knee drives at a controlled pace.

name: Pallof press
instructions: Press the handle away from your chest while resisting rotation.

name: Band Pallof press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and press out without twisting.

name: Cable wood chop
instructions: Rotate through the upper trunk while keeping hips controlled.

name: Seated torso rotation
instructions: Sit tall and rotate gently side to side without rounding the spine.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang securely and lift knees without swinging your body.

name: Captain’s chair knee raise
instructions: Support forearms and raise knees using a smooth pelvic curl.

name: Kneeling ab-wheel rollout
instructions: Brace and roll only as far as you can return without back arching.

name: Stability-ball crunch
instructions: Support your back on the ball and curl ribs toward hips gently.

name: Suitcase carry
instructions: Carry one weight at your side and walk tall without leaning.

name: Farmer carry
instructions: Carry equal weights at your sides and walk with steady posture.

name: Quadruped bird-dog hold
instructions: Pause with opposite arm and leg extended while keeping hips square.

name: Alternating heel tap
instructions: Lie on your back and reach toward each heel while keeping shoulders relaxed.

name: Brisk walk
instructions: Walk at a pace that raises breathing while still allowing conversation.

name: March in place
instructions: March steadily and swing arms naturally in a clear space.

name: Low-impact step jack
instructions: Step one foot out at a time while raising arms to a comfortable height.

name: Jumping jack
instructions: Land softly and use step jacks to reduce impact.

name: High knees
instructions: Run in place with light steps and lift knees only as comfortable.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Use small hops and a clear surface; alternate with step-throughs.

name: Stationary bike ride
instructions: Adjust seat height and pedal at a steady, sustainable effort.

name: Treadmill incline walk
instructions: Choose a comfortable incline and keep hands free from the rails if safe.

name: Steady rowing machine
instructions: Drive with legs first, then lean slightly and pull handle to ribs.

name: Elliptical steady session
instructions: Keep posture upright and choose a pace you can maintain.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: Move gently between rounded and extended spine positions with your breath.

name: Quadruped thoracic rotation
instructions: Place one hand behind your head and rotate the elbow upward slowly.

name: Seated 90/90 hip switch
instructions: Sit with knees bent and rotate both legs from side to side comfortably.

name: Adductor rockback
instructions: Extend one leg to the side and rock hips back through a gentle range.

name: Knee-to-wall ankle mobilization
instructions: Keep heel down and guide the knee toward a wall without forcing range.

name: Wall slide
instructions: Keep forearms near the wall and slide arms upward without shrugging.

name: Side-lying open book
instructions: Rotate the upper arm across your body while keeping knees stacked.

name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
instructions: Tuck pelvis gently and shift forward only until you feel a mild stretch.

name: Standing calf wall stretch
instructions: Keep heel grounded and lean toward a wall for a gentle calf stretch.

name: Supine hamstring stretch
instructions: Raise one leg with a soft knee until you feel a mild stretch.

name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, and lower with control.
